rationale: Repair reasoning topic derivation after frozen falsification proved that certified non-co-payment waiting-period evidence was collapsed into documented_fact. The repair derives concept topics generically from the existing topic-completeness catalogue by matching governed evidence requirement types, requires a unique sufficiently-supported topic match, preserves the existing conditional_copayment runtime alias, and falls back to documented_fact on absent or ambiguous concept evidence.
supersession_impact: No reasoning capability or rule is superseded. Existing rule IDs and registry contracts remain unchanged.
authority_impact: No new reasoning or recommendation authority is introduced. The repair changes only concept-topic routing for already-governed evidence and fails closed to documented_fact when catalogue evidence is ambiguous or insufficient.
